name: enhancv
description: Manage Enhancv resumes from Codex: list, read, create, upload, export (PDF), duplicate and delete.

interface.longDescription: List, read, create, upload, export as PDF, duplicate and delete resumes in an Enhancv account (Business Plus plan with an API key). Set ENHANCV_API_KEY in the environment Codex runs in.
defaultPrompt: List my Enhancv resumes and tell me which one changed last
Export my newest resume as PDF
